С  slight согните вас ваши локти вn order к prevent stress на  biceps tendon), опустите ваши руки  на обеими бокам в  wide arc пока вы чувствуете  растяжку на ваши груди. Дышите в как вы выполняете это portion вас  movement. Tip: Держите в mind that throughout  movement,  руки должны remain stationary.  movement должны только occur на  лопатки joint. Вернуться ваши руки обратно к  начальное положение как вы squeeze ваши груди muscles и exhale. Держите  contracted положение на  секунды. Tip: Make   к    same arc вас движение used к опустите  веса. Повторите  movement на  указанное количество вас повторений.

question_ru: Как делать Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In?
question_en: Как делать Incline Гантель Скамье С Ладонями От В?
answer_ru: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In. Целевые мышцы: chest, shoulders, triceps. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Lie back on an incline bench with a dumbbell on each hand on top of your thighs. The palms of your hand will be facing each other. By using your thighs to help you get the dumbbells up, clean the dumbbells one arm at a time so that you can hold them at shoulder width. Once at shoulder width, keep the palms of your hands with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). Keep your elbows flared out with the upper arms in line with the shoulders (perpendicular to the torso) and the elbows bent creating a 90-degree angle between the upper arm and the forearm. This will be your starting position. Now bring down the weights slowly to your side as you breathe in. Keep full control of the dumbbells at all times. As you breathe out, push the dumbbells up using your pectoral muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions. When you are done, place the dumbbells back in your thighs and then on the floor. This is the safest manner to dispose of the dumbbells.

Сгибая используя ваши thighs к help вы примите  гантели вверх, clean  гантели одну arm на  время so that вы можете держите им на лопатки ширине. Once на лопатки ширине, держите  ладонями вас ваши руками с  neutral grip ладонямиs от каждой другую). Держите ваши локти flared  с  верхние руки в линию с  плечам перпендикуляренr к  тело) и  локти согнуты creating  90-degree  между  верхние arm и  forearm. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Now подтяните вниз  веса медленно к ваши сторону как вы дышите в. Держите full контролем вас  гантели на все всегда. Как вы дышите , отжмитесь  гантели вверх используя ваши pectoral muscles. Lock ваши руки в  contracted положение, держите на  секунды и затем начните coming вниз медленно. Tip: Его должны take на least twice как long к опускайтесь вниз than к come вверх. Повторите  movement на  указанное количество вас повторений. question_ru: Как делать Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back?
question_en: Как делать Isometric Neck Exercise - Перед И Обратно?
answer_ru: Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back. Целевые мышцы: neck. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. With your head and neck in a neutral position (normal position with head erect facing forward), place both of your hands on the front side of your head. Now gently push forward as you contract the neck muscles but resisting any movement of your head. Start with slow tension and increase slowly. Keep breathing normally as you execute this contraction. Hold for the recommended number of seconds. Now release the tension slowly. Rest for the recommended amount of time and repeat with your hands placed on the back side of your head.

Position your body on the floor in the basic sit-up position; knees to a ninety degree angle with feet flat on the floor and arms either crossed over your chest or to the sides. This will be your starting position. As you strongly tighten your glutes and hamstrings, fill your lungs with air and in a slow (three to six second count) ascent, slowly exhale. Tip: It is important to tighten the glutes and hamstrings as this will cause the hip flexors to be inactivated in a process called reciprocal inhibition, which basically means that opposite muscles to the contracted ones will relax. As you inhale, slowly go back in a controlled manner to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Your palm should be in (neutral grip) facing the left side. Grasp the rear of the bar with your left hand. The palm of your hand should be in neutral grip alignment (palms facing the right side). Tip: Ensure that your grip is even on the bar. Your torso should be positioned right in the middle of the bar and the distance between your torso and your right hand (which should be at the front) should be the same as the distance between your torso and your left hand (which should be to your back). Now stand straight up with the weight. Tip: Your feet should be shoulder width apart and your toes slightly pointed out. Squat down by bending at the knees and keeping your back straight until your upper thighs are parallel with the floor. Tip: Keep your back as vertical as possible with the floor and your head up. Also remember to not let your knees go past your toes. Inhale during this portion of the movement. Now drive yourself back up to the starting position by pushing with the feet . Tip: Keep the bar hanging at arm's length and your elbows locked with a slight bend. The arms only serve as hooks. Avoid doing any lifting with them. Do the lifting with your thighs; not your arms.

answer_ru: Jerk Balance. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps, triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: olympic weightlifting. This drill helps you learn to drive yourself low enough during the jerk and corrects those who move backward during the movement. Begin with the bar racked in the jerk position, with the shoulders forward, torso upright, and the feet split slightly apart. Initiate the movement as you would a normal jerk, dipping at the knees while keeping your torso vertical, and driving back up forcefully, using momentum and not your arms to elevate the weight. Keep the rear foot in place, using it to drive your body forward into a full split as you jerk the weight. Recover by standing up with the weight overhead.

answer_ru: JM Press. Целевые мышцы: triceps, chest, shoulders. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Start the exercise the same way you would a close grip bench press. However, instead of having the arms perpendicular to the torso, make sure the bar is set in a direct line above the upper chest. This will be your starting position. Now beginning from a fully extended position lower the bar down as if performing a lying triceps extension. Inhale as you perform this movement. Tip: Keep the bend at the elbows constant as you bring the upper arms forward. As you exhale, press the bar back up by using the triceps to perform a close grip bench press. Now go back to the starting position and start over. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Typically, you can enter your age and weight to estimate the amount of calories burned during exercise. Elevation can be adjusted to change the intensity of the workout. Maintain proper posture as you jog, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.

Close  arm , blocking с  руки как вы would when jogging, progressing к  run и finally  sprint. Как soon как ваши руками pass  таза, accelerate им вперед during  sprinting движение к move им как быстро как possible. Смените коленями и повторите.

question_ru: Как делать Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists?
question_en: Как делать Kneeling Cable Сжимая С Alternating Oblique Twists?
answer_ru: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Connect a rope attachment to a high pulley cable and position a mat on the floor in front of it. Grab the rope with both hands and kneel approximately two feet back from the tower. Position the rope behind your head with your hands by your ears. Keep your hands in the same place, contract your abs and pull downward on the rope in a crunching movement until your elbows reach your knees. Pause briefly at the bottom and rise up in a slow and controlled manner until you reach the starting position. Repeat the same downward movement until you're halfway down, at which time you'll begin rotating one of your elbows to the opposite knee. Again, pause briefly at the bottom and rise up in a slow and controlled manner until you reach the starting position. Repeat the same movement as before, but alternate the other elbow to the opposite knee. Continue this series of movements to failure.
answer_en: Kneeling Cable Сжимая С Alternating Oblique Twists. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Connect  rope attachment к  высоко pulley cable и положение  mat на  полом в перед вас его. Grab  rope с обеими руками и станьте на колени approximately two ногами обратно от  tower. Положение  rope за ваши головой с ваши руками сгибая ваши ears. Держите ваши руками в  same месте, contract ваши прессе и подтяните downward на  rope в  crunching movement пока ваши локти reach ваши коленями. Пауза короткой на  bottom и rise вверх в  медленное и контролируемое manner пока вы reach  начальное положение. Повторите  same downward movement пока you're halfway вниз, на which время you'll начните rotating одну вас ваши локти к  opposite колено. Again, пауза короткой на  bottom и rise вверх в  медленное и контролируемое manner пока вы reach  начальное положение. Повторите  same movement как before, but alternate  другую локоть к  opposite колено. Continue это series вас movements к failure.

question_ru: Как делать Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension?
question_en: Как делать Kneeling Cable Трицепсы Extension?
answer_ru: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension. Целевые мышцы: triceps. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Place a bench sideways in front of a high pulley machine. Hold a straight bar attachment above your head with your hands about 6 inches apart with your palms facing down. Face away from the machine and kneel. Place your head and the back of your upper arms on the bench. Your elbows should be bent with the forearms pointing towards the high pulley. This will be your starting position. While keeping your upper arms close to your head at all times with the elbows in, press the bar out in a semicircular motion until the elbows are locked and your arms are parallel to the floor. Contract the triceps hard and keep this position for a second. Exhale as you perform this movement. Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Kneeling Cable Трицепсы Extension. Целевые мышцы: трицепсы. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Месте  скамье sideways в перед вас  высоко pulley . Держите  выпрямлены перекладиной attachment над ваши головой с ваши руками about 6 inches в стороны с ваши ладонями от вниз. Лицом чтобы от   и станьте на колени. Месте ваши головой и  обратно вас ваши верхние руки на  скамье. Ваши локти должны используйте согнуты с  предплечьях pointing towards  высоко pulley. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение.   держите ваши верхние руки close к ваши головой на все всегда с  локти в, нажмите  перекладиной  в  semicircular движение пока  локти     и ваши руки   параллельны к  полом. Contract  трицепсы hard и держите это положение на  секунды. Exhale как вы выполняете это movement. Медленно вернуться к  начальное положение как вы дышите в. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Kneeling Forearm Stretch. Целевые мышцы: forearms. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Start by kneeling on a mat with your palms flat and your fingers pointing back toward your knees. Slowly lean back keeping your palms flat on the floor until you feel a stretch in your wrists and forearms. Hold for 20-30 seconds.

Начните сгибая kneeling на  mat с ваши ладонями плотно и ваши fingers pointing обратно к ваши коленями. Медленно наклонитесь обратно держите ваши ладонями плотно на  полом пока вы чувствуете  растяжку в ваши wrists и предплечьях. Держите на 20-30 seconds.

question_ru: Как делать Kneeling High Pulley Row?
question_en: Как делать Kneeling Высоко Pulley Row?
answer_ru: Kneeling High Pulley Row. Целевые мышцы: lats, biceps, middle back. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Select the appropriate weight using a pulley that is above your head. Attach a rope to the cable and kneel a couple of feet away, holding the rope out in front of you with both arms extended. This will be your starting position. Initiate the movement by flexing the elbows and fully retracting your shoulders, pulling the rope toward your upper chest with your elbows out. After pausing briefly, slowly return to the starting position.
answer_en: Kneeling Высоко Pulley Row. Целевые мышцы: lats, biceps, middle обратно. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Выберите  appropriate вес используя  pulley that   над ваши головой. Закрепите  rope к  cable и станьте на колени  couple вас ногами чтобы, удерживая  rope  в перед вас вы с обеими руки вытянуты. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Initiate  movement сгибая flexing  локти и fully retracting ваши плечам, тяните  rope к ваши верхние груди с ваши локти . После с паузой короткой, медленно вернуться к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Kneeling Hip Flexor. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, quadriceps. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Kneel on a mat and bring your right knee up so the bottom of your foot is on the floor and extend your left leg out behind you so the top of your foot is on the floor. Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in your hip. Hold for 15 seconds, then repeat for your other side.
answer_en: Kneeling Таза Flexor. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, quadriceps. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Станьте на колени на  mat и подтяните ваши right колено вверх so  bottom вас ваши ноги   на  полом и выпрямите ваши left ногу  за вы so  верхние вас ваши ноги   на  полом. Перенесите ваши вес вперед пока вы чувствуете  растяжку в ваши таза. Держите на 15 seconds, затем повторите на ваши другую сторону.

answer_ru: Kneeling Jump Squat. Целевые мышцы: glutes, calves, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: expert. Категория: olympic weightlifting. Begin kneeling on the floor with a barbell racked across the back of your shoulders, or you can use your body weight for this exercise. This can be done inside of a power rack to make unracking easier. Sit back with your hips until your glutes touch your feet, keeping your head and chest up. Explode up with your hips, generating enough power to land with your feet flat on the floor. Continue with the squat by driving through your heels and extending the knees to come to a standing position.
answer_en: Kneeling Jump Присядьте. Целевые мышцы: glutes, calves, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: expert. Категория: olympic weightlifting. Начните kneeling на  полом с  barbell racked across  обратно вас ваши плечам, или вы можете   ваши тело вес на это exercise. Это можете используйте done inside вас  силы rack к make unracking easier. Сядьте обратно с ваши бедра пока ваши glutes касаться ваши ногами, держите ваши головой и груди вверх. Explode вверх с ваши бедра, generating enough силы к land с ваши ногами плотно на  полом. Continue с  присядьте сгибая driving через ваши пят и вытянув  коленями к come к  стойку положение.

question_ru: Как делать Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row?
question_en: Как делать Kneeling Single-Arm Высоко Pulley Row?
answer_ru: Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row. Целевые мышцы: lats, biceps, middle back. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Attach a single handle to a high pulley and make your weight selection. Kneel in front of the cable tower, taking the cable with one hand with your arm extended. This will be your starting position. Starting with your palm facing forward, pull the weight down to your torso by flexing the elbow and retract the shoulder blade. As you do so, rotate the wrist so that at the completion of the movement, your palm is now facing you. After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
answer_en: Kneeling Single-Arm Высоко Pulley Row. Целевые мышцы: lats, biceps, middle обратно. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Закрепите  single handle к  высоко pulley и make ваши вес selection. Станьте на колени в перед вас  cable tower, taking  cable с одну руке с ваши arm вытянуты. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Начальное с ваши palm от вперед, подтяните  вес вниз к ваши тело сгибая flexing  локоть и retract  лопатки blade. Как вы do so, rotate  wrist so that на  completion вас  movement, ваши palm   now от вы. После  brief пауза, вернуться к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Kneeling Squat. Целевые мышцы: glutes, abdominals, hamstrings, lower back. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: powerlifting. Set the bar to the proper height in a power rack. Kneel behind the bar; it may be beneficial to put a mat down to pad your knees. Slide under the bar, racking it across the back of your shoulders. Your shoulder blades should be retracted and the bar tight across your back. Unrack the weight. With your head looking forward, sit back with your butt until you touch your calves. Reverse the motion, returning the torso to an upright position.
answer_en: Kneeling Присядьте. Целевые мышцы: glutes, abdominals, hamstrings, опустите обратно. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: powerlifting. Set  перекладиной к  proper  в  силы rack. Станьте на колени за  перекладиной; его may используйте beneficial к put  mat вниз к pad ваши коленями. Сдвиньте под  перекладиной, racking его across  обратно вас ваши плечам. Ваши лопатки  должны используйте retracted и  перекладиной напряженным across ваши обратно. Unrack  вес. С ваши головой looking вперед, сядьте обратно с ваши butt пока вы касаться ваши calves. Выполните  движение, returning  тело к an upright положение.

question_ru: Как делать Knee Across The Body?
answer_ru: Knee Across The Body. Целевые мышцы: glutes, abductors, lower back. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Lie down on the floor with your right leg straight. answer_ru: Knee Circles. Целевые мышцы: calves, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Stand with your legs together and hands by your waist. Now move your knees in a circular motion as you breathe normally. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

question_ru: Как делать Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars?
question_en: Как делать Knee/Hip Поднимите На Параллельны Bars?
answer_ru: Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Position your body on the vertical leg raise bench so that your forearms are resting on the pads next to the torso and holding on to the handles. Your arms will be bent at a 90 degree angle. The torso should be straight with the lower back pressed against the pad of the machine and the legs extended pointing towards the floor. This will be your starting position. Now as you breathe out, lift your legs up as you keep them extended. Continue this movement until your legs are roughly parallel to the floor and then hold the contraction for a second. Tip: Do not use any momentum or swinging as you perform this exercise. Slowly go back to the starting position as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Knee/Hip Поднимите На Параллельны Bars. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Положение ваши тело на  vertical ногу поднимите скамье so that ваши предплечьях   лежат на  подушках next к  тело и удерживая на к  ручки. Ваши руки будет используйте согнуты на  90 градусов .  тело должны используйте выпрямлены с  опустите обратно pressed against  pad вас   и  ноги вытянуты pointing towards  полом. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Now как вы дышите , поднимите ваши ноги вверх как вы держите им вытянуты. Continue это movement пока ваши ноги   roughly параллельны к  полом и затем держите  сокращения на  секунды. Tip: Do not   any momentum или swinging как вы выполняете это exercise. Медленно опускайтесь обратно к  начальное положение как вы дышите в. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Knee Tuck Jump. Целевые мышцы: hamstrings, abductors, adductors, calves, glutes, quadriceps. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Begin in a comfortable standing position with your knees slightly bent. Hold your hands in front of you, palms down with your fingertips together at chest height. This will be your starting position. Rapidly dip down into a quarter squat and immediately explode upward. Drive the knees towards the chest, attempting to touch them to the palms of the hands. Jump as high as you can, raising your knees up, and then ensure a good land be re-extending your legs, absorbing impact through be allowing the knees to rebend.
answer_en: Колено Tuck Jump. Целевые мышцы: hamstrings, abductors, adductors, calves, glutes, quadriceps. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Rapidly dip вниз в  quarter присядьте и immediately explode вверх. Оттолкнитесь  коленями towards  груди, attempting к касаться им к  ладонями вас  руками. Jump как высоко как вы можете, raising ваши коленями вверх, и затем ensure  good land используйте re-extending ваши ноги, absorbing impact через используйте allowing  коленями к rebend.

answer_ru: Landmine 180's. Целевые мышцы: abdominals, glutes, lower back, shoulders. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Position a bar into a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight. Raise the bar from the floor, taking it to shoulder height with both hands with your arms extended in front of you. Adopt a wide stance. This will be your starting position. Perform the movement by rotating the trunk and hips as you swing the weight all the way down to one side. Keep your arms extended throughout the exercise. Reverse the motion to swing the weight all the way to the opposite side. Continue alternating the movement until the set is complete.
answer_en: Landmine 180's. Целевые мышцы: abdominals, glutes, опустите обратно, плечам. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Положение  перекладиной в  landmine или securely anchor его в  corner. Load  перекладиной к an appropriate вес. Поднимите  перекладиной от  полом, taking его к лопатки  с обеими руками с ваши руки вытянуты в перед вас вы. Adopt  wide stance. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Выполняете  movement сгибая rotating  trunk и бедра как вы качается  вес все  путь вниз к одну сторону. Держите ваши руки вытянуты throughout  exercise. Выполните  движение к качается  вес все  путь к  opposite сторону. Continue alternating  movement пока  set   complete.

answer_ru: Landmine Linear Jammer. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, abdominals, calves, chest, hamstrings, quadriceps, triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Position a bar into landmine or, lacking one, securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight and position the handle attachment on the bar. Raise the bar from the floor, taking the handles to your shoulders. This will be your starting position. In an athletic stance, squat by flexing your hips and setting your hips back, keeping your arms flexed. Reverse the motion by powerfully extending through the hips, knees, and ankles, while also extending the elbows to straighten the arms. This movement should be done explosively, coming out of the squat to full extension as powerfully as possible. Return to the starting position.
answer_en: Landmine Linear Jammer. Целевые мышцы: плечам, abdominals, calves, груди, hamstrings, quadriceps, трицепсы. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Положение  перекладиной в landmine или, lacking одну, securely anchor его в  corner. Load  перекладиной к an appropriate вес и положение  handle attachment на  перекладиной. Поднимите  перекладиной от  полом, taking  ручки к ваши плечам. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. В an athletic stance, присядьте сгибая flexing ваши бедра и setting ваши бедра обратно, держите ваши руки flexed. Выполните  движение сгибая powerfully вытянув через  бедра, коленями, и ankles,   also вытянув  локти к straighten  руки. Это movement должны используйте done explosively, coming  вас  присядьте к full extension как powerfully как possible. Вернуться к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Lateral Bound. Целевые мышцы: adductors, abductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Assume a half squat position facing 90 degrees from your direction of travel. This will be your starting position. Allow your lead leg to do a countermovement inward as you shift your weight to the outside leg. Immediately push off and extend, attempting to bound to the side as far as possible. Upon landing, immediately push off in the opposite direction, returning to your original start position. Continue back and forth for several repetitions.
answer_en: Lateral Bound. Целевые мышцы: adductors, abductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Assume  half присядьте положение от 90 градусов от ваши direction вас travel. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Allow ваши lead ногу к do  countermovement inward как вы перенесите ваши вес к  outside ногу. Immediately отжмитесь над и выпрямите, attempting к bound к  сторону как максимально как possible. Upon landing, immediately отжмитесь над в  opposite direction, returning к ваши original начните положение. Continue обратно и forth на several повторений.

answer_ru: Lateral Box Jump. Целевые мышцы: adductors, abductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Assume a comfortable standing position, with a short box positioned next to you. This will be your starting position. Quickly dip into a quarter squat to initiate the stretch reflex, and immediately reverse direction to jump up and to the side. Bring your knees high enough to ensure your feet have good clearance over the box. Land on the center of the box, using your legs to absorb the impact. Carefully jump down to the other side of the box, and continue going back and forth for several repetitions.
answer_en: Lateral Box Jump. Целевые мышцы: adductors, abductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Assume  comfortable стойку положение, с  short box positioned next к вы. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Быстро dip в  quarter присядьте к initiate  растяжку reflex, и immediately выполните direction к jump вверх и к  сторону. Подтяните ваши коленями высоко enough к ensure ваши ногами have good clearance над  box. Land на  center вас  box, используя ваши ноги к absorb  impact. Carefully jump вниз к  другую сторону вас  box, и continue выполняя обратно и forth на several повторений.

answer_ru: Lateral Cone Hops. Целевые мышцы: adductors, abductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Position a number of cones in a row several feet apart. Stand next to the end of the cones, facing 90 degrees to the direction of travel. This will be your starting position. Begin the jump by dipping with the knees to initiate a stretch reflex, and immediately reverse direction to push off the ground, jumping up and sideways over the cone. Use your legs to absorb impact upon landing, and rebound into the next jump, continuing down the row of cones.

Tip: You will need to adjust the pad so that it falls on top of your lower leg (just above your feet). Also, make sure that your legs form a 90-degree angle between the lower and upper leg. If the angle is less than 90-degrees then that means the knee is over the toes which in turn creates undue stress at the knee joint. If the machine is designed that way, either look for another machine or just make sure that when you start executing the exercise you stop going down once you hit the 90-degree angle. Using your quadriceps, extend your legs to the maximum as you exhale. Ensure that the rest of the body remains stationary on the seat. Pause a second on the contracted position. Slowly lower the weight back to the original position as you inhale, ensuring that you do not go past the 90-degree angle limit. Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

answer_ru: Lying Cambered Barbell Row. Целевые мышцы: middle back, biceps, lats, traps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Place a cambered bar underneath an exercise bench. Lie face down on the exercise bench and grab the bar using a palms down (pronated grip) that is wider than shoulder width. This will be your starting position. As you exhale row the bar up as you keep the elbows close to your body to either your chest, in order to target the upper mid back, or to your stomach if targeting the lats is your goal. After a second hold at the top, lower back down to the starting position slowly as you inhale.

question_ru: Как делать Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Extension Behind The Head?

answer_ru: Lying Close-Grip Barbell Triceps Extension Behind The Head. Целевые мышцы: triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. While holding a barbell or EZ Curl bar with a pronated grip (palms facing forward), lie on your back on a flat bench with your head close to the end of the bench. Tip: If you are holding a barbell grab it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on the inner handles. Extend your arms in front of you and slowly bring the bar back in a semi circular motion (while keeping the arms extended) to a position over your head. At the end of this step your arms should be overhead and parallel to the floor. This will be your starting position. Tip: Keep your elbows in at all times. As you inhale, lower the bar by bending at the elbows and while keeping the upper arm stationary. Keep lowering the bar until your forearms are perpendicular to the floor. As you exhale bring the bar back up to the starting position by pushing the bar up in a semi-circular motion until the lower arms are also parallel to the floor. Contract the triceps hard at the top of the movement for a second. Tip: Again, only the forearms should move. The upper arms should remain stationary at all times. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Lock your arms in the contracted position, squeeze your chest, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program. Switch arms and repeat the movement.

question_ru: Как делать One Leg Barbell Squat?

answer_ru: One Leg Barbell Squat. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: expert. Категория: strength. Start by standing about 2 to 3 feet in front of a flat bench with your back facing the bench. Have a barbell in front of you on the floor. Tip: Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other. Bend the knees and use a pronated grip with your hands being wider than shoulder width apart from each other to lift the barbell up until you can rest it on your chest. Then lift the barbell over your head and rest it on the base of your neck. Move one foot back so that your toe is resting on the flat bench. Your other foot should be stationary in front of you. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. Tip: Make sure your back is straight and chest is out while performing this exercise. As you inhale, slowly lower your leg until your thigh is parallel to the floor. At this point, your knee should be over your toes. Your chest should be directly above the middle of your thigh. Leading with the chest and hips and contracting the quadriceps, elevate your leg back to the starting position as you exhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Switch legs and repeat the movement.

question_ru: Как делать Open Palm Kettlebell Clean?

question_ru: Как делать Pallof Press With Rotation?
question_en: Как делать Pallof Нажмите С Rotation?
answer_ru: Pallof Press With Rotation. Целевые мышцы: abdominals, chest, shoulders, triceps. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Connect a standard handle to a tower, and position the cable to shoulder height. With your side to the cable, grab the handle with one hand and step away from the tower. You should be approximately arm's length away from the pulley, with the tension of the weight on the cable. Align outstretched arm with cable. With your feet positioned hip-width apart, pull the cable into your chest and grab the handle with your other hand. Both hands should be on the handle at this time. Facing forward, press the cable away from your chest. You core should be tight and engaged. Keeping your hips straight, twist your torso away from the pulley until you get a full quarter rotation. Maintain your rigid stance and straight arms. Return to the neutral position in a slow and controlled manner. Your arms should be extended in front of you. With the side tension still engaging your core, bring your hands to your chest and immediately press outward to a fully extended position. This constitutes one rep. Repeat to failure. Then, reposition and repeat the same series of movements on the opposite side.

Вы должны используйте approximately arm's length чтобы от  pulley, с  напряжение вас  вес на  cable. Align outstretched arm с cable. С ваши ногами positioned hip-width в стороны, подтяните  cable в ваши груди и grab  handle с ваши другую руке. Обеими руками должны используйте на  handle на это время. Set the pins to the desired point in your range of motion, whether it just be lockout or an inch off of your chest. The bar should be moved to the pins and prepared for lifting. Using the bar to help support your weight, lift your shoulder off the bench and retract them, squeezing the shoulder blades together. Use your feet to drive your traps into the bench. Maintain this tight body position throughout the movement. You can take a standard bench grip, or shoulder width to focus on the triceps. The bar, wrist, and elbow should stay in line at all times. Focus on squeezing the bar and trying to pull it apart. Drive the bar up with as much force as possible. The elbows should be tucked in until lockout. Return the bar to the pins, pausing before beginning the next repetition.

answer_ru: Power Clean. Целевые мышцы: hamstrings, calves, forearms, glutes, lower back, middle back, quadriceps, shoulders, traps, triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and toes pointing out slightly. Squat down and grasp bar with a closed, pronated grip. Your hands should be slightly wider than shoulder width apart outside knees with elbows fully extended. Place the bar about 1 inch in front of your shins and over the balls of your feet. Your back should be flat or slightly arched, your chest held up and out and your shoulder blades should be retracted. Keep your head in a neutral position (in line with vertebral column and not tilted or rotated) with your eyes focused straight ahead. Inhale during this phase. Lift the bar from the floor by forcefully extending the hips and the knees as you exhale. Tip: The upper torso should maintain the same angle. Do not bend at the waist yet and do not let the hips rise before the shoulders (this would have the effect of pushing the glutes in the air and stretching the hamstrings. Keep elbows fully extended with the head in a neutral position and the shoulders over the bar. As the bar raises keep it as close to the shins as possible. As the bar passes the knees, thrust your hips forward and slightly bend the knees to avoid locking them. Tip: At this point your thighs should be against the bar. Keep the back flat or slightly arched, elbows fully extended and your head neutral. Tip: You will hold your breath until the next phase. Inhale and then forcefully and quickly extend your hips and knees and stand on your toes. Keep the bar as close to your body as possible. Tip: Your back should be flat with the elbows pointed out to the sides and your head in a neutral position. Also, keep your shoulders over the bar and arms straight as long as possible. When your lower body joints are fully extended, shrug the shoulders upward rapidly without letting the elbows flex yet. Exhale during this portion of the movement. As the shoulders reach their highest elevation flex your elbows to begin pulling your body under the bar. Continue to pull the arms as high and as long as possible. Tip: Due to the explosive nature of this phase, your torso will be erect or with an arched back, your head will be tilted back slightly and your feet may lose contact with the floor. After the lower body has fully extended and the bar reaches near maximal height, pull your body under the bar and rotate the arms around and under the bar. Simultaneously, flex the hips and knees into a quarter squat position. Once the arms are under the bar, inhale and then lift your elbows to position the upper arms parallel to the floor. Rack the bar across the front of your collar bones and front shoulder muscles. Catch the bar with an erect and tight torso, a neutral head position and flat feet. Exhale during this movement. Stand up by extending the hips and knees to a fully erect position. Lower the bar by gradually reducing the muscular tension of the arms to allow a controlled descent of the bar to the thighs. Inhale during this movement. Simultaneously flex the hips and knees to cushion the impact of the bar on the thighs. Squat down with the elbows fully extended until the bar touches the floor. Start over at Phase 1 and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Continue until you have risen to a standing position, and complete the repetition by returning the weight to the boxes.

answer_ru: Rack Delivery. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, forearms, traps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: olympic weightlifting. This drill teaches the delivery of the barbell to the rack position on the shoulders. Begin holding a bar in the scarecrow position, with the upper arms parallel to the floor, and the forearms hanging down. Use a hook grip, with your fingers wrapped over your thumbs. Begin by rotating the elbows around the bar, delivering the bar to the shoulders. As your elbows come forward, relax your grip. The shoulders should be protracted, providing a shelf for the bar, which should lightly contact the throat. It is important that the bar stay close to the body at all times, as with a heavier load any distance will result in an unwanted collision. As the movement becomes smoother, speed and load can be increased before progressing further.

Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance. Also maintain a straight back and keep the knees with a slight bend; never locked. This will be your starting position. Raise your heels as you breathe out by extending your ankles as high as possible and flexing your calf. Ensure that the knee is kept stationary at all times. Go back slowly to the starting position as you breathe in by lowering your heels as you bend the ankles until calves are stretched. Now lift your toes by contracting the tibia muscles in the front of the calves as you breathe out. Hold for a second and bring them back down as you breathe in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Typically, вы можете enter ваши age и вес к estimate  количество вас calories burned during exercise. Elevation можете используйте adjusted к change  intensity вас  workout. Treadmills offer convenience, cardiovascular benefits, и usually have less impact than бегаете outside.  150 lb person будет burn над 450 calories бегаете 8 miles per hour на 30 minutes. Maintain proper posture как вы run, и только держите на  ручки when necessary, such как when dismounting или checking ваши heart rate.

answer_ru: Russian Twist. Целевые мышцы: abdominals, lower back. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees. Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position. Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out. Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Russian Поверните. Целевые мышцы: abdominals, опустите обратно. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Лягте вниз на  полом ставив ваши ногами either под something that будет not move или сгибая having  partner держите им. Ваши ноги должны используйте согнуты на  коленями. Elevate ваши верхние тело so that его creates an imaginary V-shape с ваши thighs. Ваши руки должны используйте fully вытянуты в перед вас вы перпендикулярен к ваши тело и с  руками clasped. Это    начальное положение. Поверните ваши тело к  right сторону пока ваши руки   параллельны с  полом   breathing . Держите  сокращения на  секунды и move обратно к  начальное положение   breathing . Now move к  opposite сторону performing  same techniques вы applied к  right сторону. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Sandbag Load. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abdominals, biceps, calves, forearms, glutes, hamstrings, lower back, middle back, shoulders, traps. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strongman. To load sandbags or other objects, begin with the implements placed a distance from the loading platform, typically 50 feet. Begin by lifting the sandbag. Sandbags are extremely awkward, and the manner of lifting them can vary depending on the particular sandbag used. Reach as far around it as possible, extending through the hips and knees to pull it up high. Shouldering is usually not allowed. Move as quickly as possible to the platform, and load it, extending through your hips, knees, and ankles to get it as high as possible. Place it onto the platform, ensuring it doesn't fall off. Return to the starting position to retrieve the next sandbag, and repeat until the event is completed.

Reach как максимально around его как possible, вытянув через  бедра и коленями к подтяните его вверх высоко. Shouldering   usually not allowed. Move как быстро как possible к  platform, и load его, вытянув через ваши бедра, коленями, и ankles к примите его как высоко как possible. Месте его на  platform, ensuring его doesn't fall над. Вернуться к  начальное положение к retrieve  next sandbag, и повторите пока  event   completed.

answer_ru: Scapular Pull-Up. Целевые мышцы: traps, lats, middle back. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Take a pronated grip on a pull-up bar. From a hanging position, raise yourself a few inches without using your arms. Do this by depressing your shoulder girdle in a reverse shrugging motion. Pause at the completion of the movement, and then slowly return to the starting position before performing more repetitions.
answer_en: Scapular Перекладине. Целевые мышцы: traps, lats, middle обратно. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Take  pronated grip на  перекладине перекладиной. От  свешены положение, поднимите себя  few inches без используя ваши руки. Do это сгибая depressing ваши лопатки girdle в  выполните shrugging движение. Пауза на  completion вас  movement, и затем медленно вернуться к  начальное положение before performing more повторений.

answer_ru: Scissors Jump. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Assume a lunge stance position with one foot forward with the knee bent, and the rear knee nearly touching the ground. Ensure that the front knee is over the midline of the foot. Extending through both legs, jump as high as possible, swinging your arms to gain lift. As you jump as high as you can, switch the position of your legs, moving your front leg to the back and the rear leg to the front. As you land, absorb the impact through the legs by adopting the lunge position, and repeat.
answer_en: Scissors Jump. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Assume  lunge stance положение с одну ноги вперед с  колено согнуты, и  rear колено nearly касающимися  полу. Ensure that  перед колено   над  midline вас  ноги. Вытянув через обеими ноги, jump как высоко как possible, swinging ваши руки к gain поднимите. Как вы jump как высоко как вы можете, смените  положение вас ваши ноги, moving ваши перед ногу к  обратно и  rear ногу к  перед. Как вы land, absorb  impact через  ноги сгибая adopting  lunge положение, и повторите.

answer_ru: Scissor Kick. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. To begin, lie down with your back pressed against the floor or on an exercise mat (optional). Your arms should be fully extended to the sides with your palms facing down. Note: The arms should be stationary the entire time. With a slight bend at the knees, lift your legs up so that your heels are about 6 inches off the ground. This is the starting position. Now lift your left leg up to about a 45 degree angle while your right leg is lowered until the heel is about 2-3 inches from the ground. Switch movements by raising your right leg up and lowering your left leg. Remember to breathe while performing this exercise. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Scissor Kick. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. К начните, лягте вниз с ваши обратно pressed against  полом или на an exercise mat (optional). Ваши руки должны используйте fully вытянуты к  бокам с ваши ладонями от вниз. Note:  руки должны используйте stationary  entire время. С  slight согните на  коленями, поднимите ваши ноги вверх so that ваши пят   about 6 inches над  полу. Это    начальное положение. Now поднимите ваши left ногу вверх к about  45 градусов    ваши right ногу   lowered пока  heel   about 2-3 inches от  полу. Смените movements сгибая raising ваши right ногу вверх и lowering ваши left ногу. Remember к дышите   performing это exercise. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

question_ru: Как делать Seated Band Hamstring Curl?
question_en: Как делать Seated Ленту Hamstring Curl?
answer_ru: Seated Band Hamstring Curl. Целевые мышцы: hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Secure a band close to the ground and place a bench a couple feet away from it. Seat yourself on the bench and secure the band behind your ankles, beginning with your legs straight. This will be your starting position. Flex the knees, bringing your feet towards the bench. You may need to lean back slightly to keep your feet from striking the floor. Pause at the completion of the movement, and then slowly return to the starting position.
answer_en: Seated Ленту Hamstring Curl. Целевые мышцы: hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Закрепите  ленту close к  полу и месте  скамье  couple ногами чтобы от его. Seat себя на  скамье и закрепите  ленту за ваши ankles, beginning с ваши ноги выпрямлены. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Согните  коленями, bringing ваши ногами towards  скамье. Вы may need к наклонитесь обратно немного к держите ваши ногами от striking  полом. Пауза на  completion вас  movement, и затем медленно вернуться к  начальное положение.

question_ru: Как делать Seated Barbell Military Press?
question_en: Как делать Seated Barbell Military Нажмите?
answer_ru: Seated Barbell Military Press. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Sit on a Military Press Bench with a bar behind your head and either have a spotter give you the bar (better on the rotator cuff this way) or pick it up yourself carefully with a pronated grip (palms facing forward). Tip: Your grip should be wider than shoulder width and it should create a 90-degree angle between the forearm and the upper arm as the barbell goes down. Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip length, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Hold at about shoulder level and slightly in front of your head. This is your starting position. Lower the bar down to the collarbone slowly as you inhale. Lift the bar back up to the starting position as you exhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Seated Barbell Military Нажмите. Целевые мышцы: плечам, трицепсы. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Сядьте на  Military Нажмите Скамье с  перекладиной за ваши головой и either have  spotter give вы  перекладиной (better на  rotator cuff это путь) или pick его вверх себя carefully с  pronated grip ладонямиs от вперед). Tip: Ваши grip должны используйте wider than лопатки ширине и его должны create  90-degree  между  forearm и  верхние arm как  barbell goes вниз. Once вы pick вверх  barbell с  correct grip length, поднимите  перекладиной вверх над ваши головой сгибая locking ваши руки. Держите на about лопатки  и немного в перед вас ваши головой. Это   ваши начальное положение. Опустите  перекладиной вниз к  collarbone медленно как вы inhale. Поднимите  перекладиной обратно вверх к  начальное положение как вы exhale. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Seated Barbell Twist. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Start out by sitting at the end of a flat bench with a barbell placed on top of your thighs. Your feet should be shoulder width apart from each other. Grip the bar with your palms facing down and make sure your hands are wider than shoulder width apart from each other. Begin to lift the barbell up over your head until your arms are fully extended. Now lower the barbell behind your head until it is resting along the base of your neck. This is the starting position. While keeping your feet and head stationary, move your waist from side to side so that your oblique muscles feel the contraction. Only move from side to side as far as your waist will allow you to go. Stretching or moving too far can cause an injury to occur. Tip: Use a slow and controlled motion. Remember to breathe out while twisting your body to the side and in when moving back to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Seated Barbell Поверните. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Начните  сгибая sitting на  конце вас  плотно скамье с  barbell placed на верхние вас ваши thighs. Ваши ногами должны используйте лопатки ширине в стороны от каждой другую. Grip  перекладиной с ваши ладонями от вниз и make   ваши руками   wider than лопатки ширине в стороны от каждой другую. Начните к поднимите  barbell вверх над ваши головой пока ваши руки   fully вытянуты. Now опустите  barbell за ваши головой пока его   лежат along  base вас ваши neck. Это    начальное положение.   держите ваши ногами и головой stationary, move ваши waist от сторону к сторону so that ваши oblique muscles чувствуете  сокращения. Только move от сторону к сторону как максимально как ваши waist будет allow вы к опускайтесь. Вытягивая или moving too максимально можете cause an injury к occur. Tip:    медленное и контролируемое движение. Remember к дышите    twisting ваши тело к  сторону и в when moving обратно к  начальное положение. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

question_ru: Как делать Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension?
question_en: Как делать Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Гантель Трицепсы Extension?
answer_ru: Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension. Целевые мышцы: triceps. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Sit down at the end of a flat bench with a dumbbell in one arm using a neutral grip (palms of the hand facing you). Bend your knees slightly and bring your torso forward, by bending at the waist, while keeping the back straight until it is almost parallel to the floor. Make sure that you keep the head up. The upper arm with the dumbbell should be close to the torso and aligned with it (lifted up until it is parallel to the floor while the forearms are pointing towards the floor as the hands hold the weights). Tip: There should be a 90-degree angle between the forearms and the upper arm. This is your starting position. Keeping the upper arm stationary, use the triceps to lift the weight as you exhale until the forearm is parallel to the floor and the whole arm is extended. Like many other arm exercises, only the forearm moves. After a second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions. Switch arms and repeat the exercise.
answer_en: Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Гантель Трицепсы Extension. Целевые мышцы: трицепсы. Оборудование: гантель. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Сядьте вниз на  конце вас  плотно скамье с  гантель в одну arm используя  neutral grip ладонямиs вас  руке от вы). Согните ваши коленями немного и подтяните ваши тело вперед, сгибая сгибая на  waist,   держите  обратно выпрямлены пока его   almost параллельны к  полом. Make   that вы держите  головой вверх.  верхние arm с  гантель должны используйте close к  тело и aligned с его (lifted вверх пока его   параллельны к  полом    предплечьях   pointing towards  полом как  руками держите  веса). Tip: There должны используйте  90-degree  между  предплечьях и  верхние arm. Это   ваши начальное положение. Держите  верхние arm stationary,    трицепсы к поднимите  вес как вы exhale пока  forearm   параллельны к  полом и  whole arm   вытянуты. Like many другую arm exercises, только  forearm moves. После  секунды сокращения на  верхние, медленно опустите  гантель обратно к  начальное положение как вы inhale. Повторите  movement на  указанное количество вас повторений. Смените руки и повторите  exercise.

question_ru: Как делать Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise?
question_en: Как делать Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Поднимите?
answer_ru: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise. Целевые мышцы: shoulders. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Place a couple of dumbbells looking forward in front of a flat bench. Sit on the end of the bench with your legs together and the dumbbells behind your calves. Bend at the waist while keeping the back straight in order to pick up the dumbbells. The palms of your hands should be facing each other as you pick them. This will be your starting position. Keeping your torso forward and stationary, and the arms slightly bent at the elbows, lift the dumbbells straight to the side until both arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you lift the weights. (Note: avoid swinging the torso or bringing the arms back as opposed to the side.) After a one second contraction at the top, slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Поднимите. Целевые мышцы: плечам. Оборудование: гантель. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Месте  couple вас гантели looking вперед в перед вас  плотно скамье. Сядьте на  конце вас  скамье с ваши ноги вместе и  гантели за ваши calves. Согните на  waist   держите  обратно выпрямлены в order к pick вверх  гантели.  ладонями вас ваши руками должны используйте от каждой другую как вы pick им. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Держите ваши тело вперед и stationary, и  руки немного согнуты на  локти, поднимите  гантели выпрямлены к  сторону пока обеими руки   параллельны к  полом. Exhale как вы поднимите  веса. (Note: avoid swinging  тело или bringing  руки обратно как opposed к  сторону.) После  одну секунды сокращения на  верхние, медленно опустите  гантели обратно к  начальное положение. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your partner standing behind you. Extend your arms straight behind you with your palms facing each other. Your partner will hold your wrists for you. This will be the starting position. Attempt to flex your elbows, while your partner prevents any actual movement. After 10-20 seconds, relax your arms while your partner gently pulls your wrists up to stretch your biceps. Be sure to let your partner know when the stretch is appropriate to prevent injury or overstretching.

answer_ru: Seated Cable Rows. Целевые мышцы: middle back, biceps, lats, shoulders. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. For this exercise you will need access to a low pulley row machine with a V-bar. Note: The V-bar will enable you to have a neutral grip where the palms of your hands face each other. To get into the starting position, first sit down on the machine and place your feet on the front platform or crossbar provided making sure that your knees are slightly bent and not locked. Lean over as you keep the natural alignment of your back and grab the V-bar handles. With your arms extended pull back until your torso is at a 90-degree angle from your legs. Your back should be slightly arched and your chest should be sticking out. You should be feeling a nice stretch on your lats as you hold the bar in front of you. This is the starting position of the exercise. Keeping the torso stationary, pull the handles back towards your torso while keeping the arms close to it until you touch the abdominals. Breathe out as you perform that movement. At that point you should be squeezing your back muscles hard. Hold that contraction for a second and slowly go back to the original position while breathing in. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение.   maintaining  тело stationary (no swinging), поднимите  гантели к ваши сторону с  slight согните на  локоть и  руками немного tilted вперед как как если pouring water в  glass. Continue к опускайтесь вверх пока вы руки   параллельны к  полом. Exhale как вы execute это movement и пауза на  секунды на  верхние. Опустите  гантели обратно вниз медленно к  начальное положение как вы inhale. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Seated Triceps Press. Целевые мышцы: triceps. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Sit down on a bench with back support and grasp a dumbbell with both hands and hold it overhead at arm's length. Tip: a better way is to have somebody hand it to you especially if it is very heavy. The resistance should be resting in the palms of your hands with your thumbs around it. The palm of the hand should be facing inward. This will be your starting position. Keeping your upper arms close to your head (elbows in) and perpendicular to the floor, lower the resistance in a semi-circular motion behind your head until your forearms touch your biceps. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step. Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the dumbbell. Breathe out as you perform this step. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Seated Трицепсы Нажмите. Целевые мышцы: трицепсы. Оборудование: гантель. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Сядьте вниз на  скамье с обратно support и grasp  гантель с обеими руками и держите его над головой на arm's length. Tip:  better путь   к have somebody руке его к вы especially как если его   very heavy.  сопротивление должны используйте лежат в  ладонями вас ваши руками с ваши thumbs around его.  palm вас  руке должны используйте от inward. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Держите ваши верхние руки close к ваши головой локтиs в) и перпендикулярен к  полом, опустите  сопротивление в  semi-circular движение за ваши головой пока ваши предплечьях касаться ваши biceps. Tip:  верхние руки должны remain stationary и только  предплечьях должны move. Дышите в как вы выполняете это отойдите. Опускайтесь обратно к  начальное положение сгибая используя  трицепсы к поднимите  гантель. Дышите  как вы выполняете это отойдите. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

question_ru: Как делать Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl?
question_en: Как делать Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl?
answer_ru: Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl. Целевые мышцы: forearms. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Put a bench in front of a low pulley machine that has a barbell or EZ Curl attachment on it. Move the bench far enough away so that when you bring the handle to the top of your thighs tension is created on the cable due to the weight stack being moved up. Now hold the handle with both hands, palms up, using a shoulder-width grip. Step back and sit on the bench with your feet about shoulder width apart, firmly on the floor. Lean forward and place the forearms on your thighs with the back of your wrists over your knees. This will be your starting position. Lower the bar as far as possible, while inhaling and keeping a tight grip. Now curl the bar up as high as possible while contracting the forearms. Tip: Only the wrist should move; not the forearms. After a second contraction at the top go back to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Seated Two-Arm Palms-Up Low-Pulley Wrist Curl. Целевые мышцы: предплечьях. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Put  скамье в перед вас  low pulley  that has  barbell или EZ Curl attachment на его. Move  скамье максимально enough чтобы so that when вы подтяните  handle к  верхние вас ваши thighs напряжение   created на  cable due к  вес stack being moved вверх. Now держите  handle с обеими руками, ладонями вверх, используя  shoulder-width grip. Отойдите обратно и сядьте на  скамье с ваши ногами about лопатки ширине в стороны, firmly на  полом. Наклонитесь вперед и месте  предплечьях на ваши thighs с  обратно вас ваши wrists над ваши коленями. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Опустите  перекладиной как максимально как possible,   inhaling и держите  напряженным grip. Now curl  перекладиной вверх как высоко как possible   contracting  предплечьях. Tip: Только  wrist должны move; not  предплечьях. После  секунды сокращения на  верхние опускайтесь обратно к  начальное положение как вы inhale. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.
