question_ru: Как делать See-Saw Press (Alternating Side Press)?
question_en: Как делать See-Saw Нажмите (Alternating Сторону Нажмите)?
answer_ru: See-Saw Press (Alternating Side Press). Целевые мышцы: shoulders, abdominals, triceps. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Grab a dumbbell with each hand and stand up erect. Clean (lift) the dumbbells to the chest/shoulder level and then rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing towards you as if you were getting ready to perform an Arnold Press. This will be your starting position. Now start extending your left arm overhead as you rotate the wrist so that the palm of your hand faces forward as you go up. Your elbows should come out also as you lift the weight. Simultaneously, you will also be bending from your hip to your opposite side. Tip: If you perform the exercise correctly, is should look as if you are trying to reach for something overhead on the right hand side of your body, but with your left arm. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Once you reach the top position breathe in. Then, with the weight fully extended overhead and you bent over to your right hand side, begin the movement to the left side. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: See-Saw Нажмите (Alternating Сторону Нажмите). Целевые мышцы: плечам, abdominals, трицепсы. Оборудование: гантель. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Grab  гантель с каждой руке и встаньте вверх erect. Clean поднимитеt)  гантели к  chest/shoulder  и затем rotate ваши wrists so that ваши ладонями   от towards вы как как если вы were getting ready к выполняете an Arnold Нажмите. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Now начните вытянув ваши left arm над головой как вы rotate  wrist so that  palm вас ваши руке faces вперед как вы опускайтесь вверх. Ваши локти должны come  also как вы поднимите  вес. Simultaneously, вы будет also используйте сгибая от ваши таза к ваши opposite сторону. Tip: Как если вы выполняете  exercise correctly,   должны look как как если вы   trying к reach на something над головой на  right руке сторону вас ваши тело, but с ваши left arm. Дышите  как вы выполняете это movement. Once вы reach  верхние положение дышите в. Затем, с  вес fully вытянуты над головой и вы согнуты над к ваши right руке сторону, начните  movement к  left сторону. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Shotgun Row. Целевые мышцы: lats, biceps, middle back. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Attach a single handle to a low cable. After selecting the correct weight, stand a couple feet back with a wide-split stance. Your arm should be extended and your shoulder forward. This will be your starting position. Perform the movement by retracting the shoulder and flexing the elbow. As you pull, supinate the wrist, turning the palm upward as you go. After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
answer_en: Shotgun Row. Целевые мышцы: lats, biceps, middle обратно. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Закрепите  single handle к  low cable. После selecting  correct вес, встаньте  couple ногами обратно с  wide-split stance. Ваши arm должны используйте вытянуты и ваши лопатки вперед. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Выполняете  movement сгибая retracting  лопатки и flexing  локоть. Как вы подтяните, supinate  wrist, turning  palm вверх как вы опускайтесь. После  brief пауза, вернуться к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Shoulder Circles. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, traps. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. With shoulders relaxed and arms resting loosely at your sides (or in your lap if you're seated), gently roll your shoulders forward, up, back, and down. Reverse direction. You can do this exercise alternating shoulders or both at the same time.
answer_en: Лопатки Circles. Целевые мышцы: плечам, traps. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. С плечам relaxed и руки лежат loosely на ваши бокам илиr в ваши lap как если you're seated), осторожно прокатывайте ваши плечам вперед, вверх, обратно, и вниз. Выполните direction. Вы можете do это exercise alternating плечам или обеими на  same время.

question_ru: Как делать Shoulder Press - With Bands?
question_en: Как делать Лопатки Нажмите - С Bands?
answer_ru: Shoulder Press - With Bands. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, triceps. Оборудование: bands. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. To begin, stand on an exercise band so that tension begins at arm's length. Grasp the handles and lift them so that the hands are at shoulder height at each side. Rotate the wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward. Your elbows should be bent, with the upper arms and forearms in line to the torso. This is your starting position. As you exhale, lift the handles up until your arms are fully extended overhead.
answer_en: Лопатки Нажмите - С Bands. Целевые мышцы: плечам, трицепсы. Оборудование: bands. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. К начните, встаньте на an exercise ленту so that напряжение begins на arm's length. Grasp  ручки и поднимите им so that  руками   на лопатки  на каждой сторону. Rotate  wrists so that  ладонями вас ваши руками   от вперед. Ваши локти должны используйте согнуты, с  верхние руки и предплечьях в линию к  тело. Это   ваши начальное положение. Как вы exhale, поднимите  ручки вверх пока ваши руки   fully вытянуты над головой.

answer_ru: Shoulder Raise. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, lats. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Relax your arms to your sides and raise your shoulders up toward your ears, then back down.
answer_en: Лопатки Поднимите. Целевые мышцы: плечам, lats. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Relax ваши руки к ваши бокам и поднимите ваши плечам вверх к ваши ears, затем обратно вниз.

answer_ru: Shoulder Stretch. Целевые мышцы: shoulders. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Reach your left arm across your body and hold it straight.
answer_en: Лопатки Растяжку. Целевые мышцы: плечам. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Reach ваши left arm across ваши тело и держите его выпрямлены.

answer_ru: Side-Lying Floor Stretch. Целевые мышцы: lats. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. First lie on your left side, bending your left knee in front of you to stabilize your torso (use your abdominal muscles as well to hold you upright). Straighten your right leg and rest the right foot on the floor behind your left. Straighten your right arm over your head and gently pull on your right wrist to stretch the entire right side of the body. Switch sides.
answer_en: Side-Lying Полом Растяжку. Целевые мышцы: lats. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. First лягте на ваши left сторону, сгибая ваши left колено в перед вас вы к stabilize ваши тело  e ваши abdominal muscles как well к держите вы upright). Straighten ваши right ногу и положите  right ноги на  полом за ваши left. Straighten ваши right arm над ваши головой и осторожно подтяните на ваши right wrist к растяжку  entire right сторону вас  тело. Смените бокам.

answer_ru: Side Bridge. Целевые мышцы: abdominals, shoulders. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Инструкция отсутствует.
answer_en: Сторону Bridge. Целевые мышцы: abdominals, плечам. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Инструкция отсутствует.

answer_ru: Side Hop-Sprint. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Stand to the side of a cone or hurdle. Begin this drill by hopping sideways over the obstacle, rebounding out of your landing to hop back to where you started. Hop for a prescribed number or repetitions as quickly as possible, and finish this drill by sprinting a short distance upon landing the last hop.
answer_en: Сторону Hop-Sprint. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Встаньте к  сторону вас  cone или hurdle. Начните это drill сгибая hopping sideways над  obstacle, rebounding  вас ваши landing к hop обратно к where вы started. Hop на  указанное number или повторений как быстро как possible, и finish это drill сгибая sprinting  short distance upon landing  last hop.

answer_ru: Side Jackknife. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Инструкция отсутствует.
answer_en: Сторону Jackknife. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Инструкция отсутствует.

question_ru: Как делать Side Laterals to Front Raise?
question_en: Как делать Сторону Laterals к Перед Поднимите?
answer_ru: Side Laterals to Front Raise. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, traps. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. In a standing position, hold a pair of dumbbells at your side. This will be your starting position. Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the weights directly in front of you to shoulder height, avoiding any swinging or cheating. At the top of the exercise move the weights out in front of you, keeping your arms extended. Lower the weights with a controlled motion. On the next repetition, raise the weights in front of you to shoulder height before moving the weights laterally to your sides. Lower the weights to the starting position.
answer_en: Сторону Laterals к Перед Поднимите. Целевые мышцы: плечам, traps. Оборудование: гантель. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. В  стойку положение, держите  pair вас гантели на ваши сторону. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Держите ваши локти немного согнуты, поднимите  веса directly в перед вас вы к лопатки , avoiding any swinging или cheating. На  верхние вас  exercise move  веса  в перед вас вы, держите ваши руки вытянуты. Опустите  веса с  контролируемое движение. На  next repetition, поднимите  веса в перед вас вы к лопатки  before moving  веса laterally к ваши бокам. Опустите  веса к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Side Lateral Raise. Целевые мышцы: shoulders. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Pick a couple of dumbbells and stand with a straight torso and the dumbbells by your side at arms length with the palms of the hand facing you. This will be your starting position. While maintaining the torso in a stationary position (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top. Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Сторону Lateral Поднимите. Целевые мышцы: плечам. Оборудование: гантель. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Pick  couple вас гантели и встаньте с  выпрямлены тело и  гантели сгибая ваши сторону на руки length с  ладонями вас  руке от вы. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение.   maintaining  тело в  stationary положение (no swinging), поднимите  гантели к ваши сторону с  slight согните на  локоть и  руками немного tilted вперед как как если pouring water в  glass. Continue к опускайтесь вверх пока вы руки   параллельны к  полом. Exhale как вы execute это movement и пауза на  секунды на  верхние. Опустите  гантели обратно вниз медленно к  начальное положение как вы inhale. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Side Leg Raises. Целевые мышцы: adductors. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Stand next to a chair, which you may hold onto as a support. Stand on one leg. This will be your starting position. Keeping your leg straight, raise it as far out to the side as possible, and swing it back down, allowing it to cross the opposite leg. Repeat this swinging motion 5-10 times, increasing the range of motion as you do so.
answer_en: Сторону Ногу Raises. Целевые мышцы: adductors. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Встаньте next к  chair, which вы may держите на как  support. Встаньте на одну ногу. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Держите ваши ногу выпрямлены, поднимите его как максимально  к  сторону как possible, и качается его обратно вниз, allowing его к cross  opposite ногу. Повторите это swinging движение 5-10 всегда, increasing  range вас движение как вы do so.

question_ru: Как делать Side Lying Groin Stretch?
question_en: Как делать Сторону Lying Groin Растяжку?
answer_ru: Side Lying Groin Stretch. Целевые мышцы: adductors, hamstrings. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Start off by lying on your right side and bend your right knee in front of you to stabilize the torso. Rest your head on your right hand or shoulder. Lift your left leg upward and hold it by the back of the knee (easier) or the foot (harder). Pull your left knee in toward your left shoulder and simultaneously press your foot or knee down to the floor. To intensify this stretch, straighten your left leg. Switch sides.
answer_en: Сторону Lying Groin Растяжку. Целевые мышцы: adductors, hamstrings. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Начните над сгибая lying на ваши right сторону и согните ваши right колено в перед вас вы к stabilize  тело. Положите ваши головой на ваши right руке или лопатки. Поднимите ваши left ногу вверх и держите его сгибая  обратно вас  колено (easier) или  ноги (harder). Подтяните ваши left колено в к ваши left лопатки и simultaneously нажмите ваши ноги или колено вниз к  полом. К intensify это растяжку, straighten ваши left ногу. Смените бокам.

answer_ru: Side Neck Stretch. Целевые мышцы: neck. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder. Assist stretch with a gentle pull on the side of the head.
answer_en: Сторону Neck Растяжку. Целевые мышцы: neck. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Начните с ваши плечам relaxed, осторожно tilt ваши головой towards ваши лопатки. Assist растяжку с  gentle подтяните на  сторону вас  головой.

question_ru: Как делать Side Standing Long Jump?
question_en: Как делать Сторону Стойку Long Jump?
answer_ru: Side Standing Long Jump. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Begin standing with your feet hip width apart in an athletic stance. Your head and chest should be up, knees and hips slightly bent. This will be your starting position. Leaning to your right, extend through your hips, knees, and ankles to jump into the air. Block with the arms to lead the movement, jumping as far to your right as you can. Land facing the same direction with your feet hip width apart, absorbing the impact through your lower body.
answer_en: Сторону Стойку Long Jump. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Начните стойку с ваши ногами таза ширине в стороны в an athletic stance. Ваши головой и груди должны используйте вверх, коленями и бедра немного согнуты. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Leaning к ваши right, выпрямите через ваши бедра, коленями, и ankles к jump в  вверх. Block с  руки к lead  movement, jumping как максимально к ваши right как вы можете. Land от  same direction с ваши ногами таза ширине в стороны, absorbing  impact через ваши опустите тело.

question_ru: Как делать Side to Side Box Shuffle?
question_en: Как делать Сторону к Сторону Box Shuffle?
answer_ru: Side to Side Box Shuffle. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Stand to one side of the box with your left foot resting on the middle of it. To begin, jump up and over to the other side of the box, landing with your right foot on top of the box and your left foot on the floor. Swing your arms to aid your movement. Continue shuffling back and forth across the box.
answer_en: Сторону к Сторону Box Shuffle. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Встаньте к одну сторону вас  box с ваши left ноги лежат на  middle вас его. question_ru: Как делать Side To Side Chins?
question_en: Как делать Сторону К Сторону Chins?
answer_ru: Side To Side Chins. Целевые мышцы: lats, biceps, forearms, middle back, shoulders. Оборудование: other. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at a wide grip, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position. Pull your torso up while leaning to the left hand side until the bar almost touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space (no swinging) and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar. After a second of contraction, inhale as you go back to the starting position. Now, pull your torso up while leaning to the right hand side until the bar almost touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar. After a second of contraction, inhale as you go back to the starting position. Repeat steps 3-6 until you have performed the prescribed amount of repetitions for each side.

Как вы have обеими руки вытянуты в перед вас вы удерживая  перекладиной на  wide grip, подтяните ваши тело обратно around 30 градусов или so   creating  curvature на ваши опустите обратно и sticking ваши груди . Exhale как вы выполняете это portion вас  movement. После  секунды вас сокращения, inhale как вы опускайтесь обратно к  начальное положение. Now, подтяните ваши тело вверх   leaning к  right руке сторону пока  перекладиной almost touches ваши верхние груди сгибая drawing  плечам и  верхние руки вниз и обратно. После  секунды вас сокращения, inhale как вы опускайтесь обратно к  начальное положение. Повторите steps 3-6 пока вы have performed  указанное количество вас повторений на каждой сторону.

answer_ru: Side Wrist Pull. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, forearms, lats. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. This stretch works best standing. Cross your left arm over the midline of your body and hold the left wrist in your right hand down at the level of your hips. Start the stretch with a bent left arm. Slowly straighten, pull, and lift it up to shoulder height, as pictured. Feel this stretch originate in your back, not your shoulders, and don't pull too hard on the shoulders joint. Switch sides.
answer_en: Сторону Wrist Подтяните. Целевые мышцы: плечам, предплечьях, lats. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Это растяжку works best стойку. Cross ваши left arm над  midline вас ваши тело и держите  left wrist в ваши right руке вниз на   вас ваши бедра. Начните  растяжку с  согнуты left arm. Медленно straighten, подтяните, и поднимите его вверх к лопатки , как pictured. Чувствуете это растяжку originate в ваши обратно, not ваши плечам, и don't подтяните too hard на  плечам joint. Смените бокам.

answer_ru: Single-Arm Cable Crossover. Целевые мышцы: chest. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Begin by moving the pulleys to the high position, select the resistance to be used, and take a handle in each hand. Step forward in front of both pulleys with your arms extended in front of you, bringing your hands together. Your head and chest should be up as you lean forward, while your feet should be staggered. This will be your starting position. Keeping your left arm in place, allow your right arm to extend out to the side, maintaining a slight bend at the elbow. The right arm should be perpendicular to the body at approximately shoulder level. Return your arm back to the starting position by pulling your hand back to the midline of the body. Hold for a second at the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side. Continue alternating back and forth for the prescribed number of repetitions.
answer_en: Single-Arm Cable Crossover. Целевые мышцы: груди. Оборудование: cable. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Начните сгибая moving  pulleys к  высоко положение, выберите  сопротивление к используйте used, и take  handle в каждой руке. Отойдите вперед в перед вас обеими pulleys с ваши руки вытянуты в перед вас вы, bringing ваши руками вместе. Ваши головой и груди должны используйте вверх как вы наклонитесь вперед,   ваши ногами должны используйте staggered. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Держите ваши left arm в месте, allow ваши right arm к выпрямите  к  сторону, maintaining  slight согните на  локоть.  right arm должны используйте перпендикулярен к  тело на approximately лопатки . Вернуться ваши arm обратно к  начальное положение сгибая тяните ваши руке обратно к  midline вас  тело. Держите на  секунды на  начальное положение и повторите  movement на  opposite сторону. Continue alternating обратно и forth на  указанное number вас повторений.

answer_ru: Single-Arm Linear Jammer. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, chest, triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Position a bar into a landmine or securely anchor it in a corner. Load the bar to an appropriate weight. Raise the bar from the floor, taking it to your shoulders with one or both hands. Adopt a wide stance. This will be your starting position. Perform the movement by extending the elbow, pressing the weight up. Move explosively, extending the hips and knees fully to produce maximal force. Return to the starting position.
answer_en: Single-Arm Linear Jammer. Целевые мышцы: плечам, груди, трицепсы. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Положение  перекладиной в  landmine или securely anchor его в  corner. Load  перекладиной к an appropriate вес. Поднимите  перекладиной от  полом, taking его к ваши плечам с одну или обеими руками. Adopt  wide stance. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Выполняете  movement сгибая вытянув  локоть, pressing  вес вверх. Move explosively, вытянув  бедра и коленями fully к produce maximal force. Вернуться к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Single-Arm Push-Up. Целевые мышцы: chest, shoulders, triceps. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Begin laying prone on the ground. Move yourself into a position supporting your weight on your toes and one arm. Your working arm should be placed directly under the shoulder, fully extended. Your legs should be extended, and for this movement you may need a wider base, placing your feet further apart than in a normal push-up. Maintain good posture, and place your free hand behind your back. This will be your starting position. Lower yourself by allowing the elbow to flex until you touch the ground. Descend slowly, and reverse direction be extending the arm to return to the starting position.
answer_en: Single-Arm Push-Up. Целевые мышцы: груди, плечам, трицепсы. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Начните laying prone на  полу. Move себя в  положение supporting ваши вес на ваши пальцами ног и одну arm. Ваши working arm должны используйте placed directly под  лопатки, fully вытянуты. Ваши ноги должны используйте вытянуты, и на это movement вы may need  wider base, ставив ваши ногами further в стороны than в  normal push-up. Maintain good posture, и месте ваши free руке за ваши обратно. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Опустите себя сгибая allowing  локоть к согните пока вы касаться  полу. Descend медленно, и выполните direction используйте вытянув  arm к вернуться к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Single-Cone Sprint Drill. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. This drill teaches quick foot action. You need a single cone. Begin standing next to the cone with one arm back and one arm forward. Chop the feet as quickly as possible, blocking with the arms. Circle the cone, keep your knees up, with violent foot action. Rest after three trips around the cone.
answer_en: Single-Cone Sprint Drill. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Это drill teaches quick ноги action. Вы need  single cone. Начните стойку next к  cone с одну arm обратно и одну arm вперед. Chop  ногами как быстро как possible, blocking с  руки. Circle  cone, держите ваши коленями вверх, с violent ноги action. Положите после three trips around  cone.

question_ru: Как делать Single-Leg High Box Squat?
question_en: Как делать Single-Leg Высоко Box Присядьте?
answer_ru: Single-Leg High Box Squat. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Position a box in a rack. Secure a band or rope in place above the box. Standing in front of it, step onto the box to a full standing position, letting your other leg remain unsupported. Hold onto the band for balance . Continue stepping up and down on the same leg before switching to the opposite side.
answer_en: Single-Leg Высоко Box Присядьте. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Положение  box в  rack. Закрепите  ленту или rope в месте над  box. Стойку в перед вас его, отойдите на  box к  full стойку положение, позволяя ваши другую ногу remain unsupported. Держите на  ленту на равновесие . Continue stepping вверх и вниз на  same ногу before switching к  opposite сторону.

answer_ru: Single-Leg Hop Progression. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Arrange a line of cones in front of you. Assume a relaxed standing position, balanced on one leg. Raise the knee of your opposite leg. This will be your starting position. Hop forward, jumping and landing with the same leg over the cone. Use a countermovement jump to hop from cone to cone. At the end, turn around and go back on the other leg.
answer_en: Single-Leg Hop Progression. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Arrange  линию вас cones в перед вас вы. Assume  relaxed стойку положение, balanced на одну ногу. Поднимите  колено вас ваши opposite ногу. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Hop вперед, jumping и landing с  same ногу над  cone.    countermovement jump к hop от cone к cone. На  конце, turn around и опускайтесь обратно на  другую ногу.

answer_ru: Single-Leg Lateral Hop. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Stand to the side of a cone or hurdle. To get into the start position, stand on one leg with your knee slightly bent. To begin, execute a counterjump to hop sideways over the cone. Land on your jumping leg, and immediately rebound out of it by jumping back to the start position. Continue hopping back and forth.
answer_en: Single-Leg Lateral Hop. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Встаньте к  сторону вас  cone или hurdle. К примите в  начните положение, встаньте на одну ногу с ваши колено немного согнуты. К начните, execute  counterjump к hop sideways над  cone. Land на ваши jumping ногу, и immediately rebound  вас его сгибая jumping обратно к  начните положение. Continue hopping обратно и forth.

answer_ru: Single-Leg Leg Extension. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps. Оборудование: machine. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Seat yourself in the machine and adjust it so that you are positioned properly. The pad should be against the lower part of the shin but not in contact with the ankle. Adjust the seat so that the pivot point is in line with your knee. Select a weight appropriate for your abilities. Maintaining good posture, fully extend one leg, pausing at the top of the motion. Return to the starting position without letting the weight stop, keeping tension on the muscle. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Вернуться к  начальное положение без позволяя  вес stop, держите напряжение на  muscle. Повторите на  desired number вас повторений.

answer_ru: Single-Leg Stride Jump. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Stand to the side of a box with your inside foot on top of it, close to the edge. Begin by swinging the arms upward as you push through the top leg, jumping upward as high as possible. Attempt to drive the opposite knee upward. Land in the same position that you started, using your inside leg to decelerate the impact.
answer_en: Single-Leg Stride Jump. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Встаньте к  сторону вас  box с ваши inside ноги на верхние вас его, close к  краю. Начните сгибая swinging  руки вверх как вы отжмитесь через  верхние ногу, jumping вверх как высоко как possible. Attempt к оттолкнитесь  opposite колено вверх. Land в  same положение that вы started, используя ваши inside ногу к decelerate  impact.

answer_ru: Single Dumbbell Raise. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, forearms, traps. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. With a wide stance, hold a dumbell with both hands, grasping the head of the dumbbell instead of the handle. Your arms should be extended and hanging at the waist. This will be your starting position. Raise the weight until it is above shoulder level, keeping your arms extended. Your torso and hips should remain stationary throughout the movement. Return to the starting position and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Single Гантель Поднимите. Целевые мышцы: плечам, предплечьях, traps. Оборудование: гантель. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. С  wide stance, держите  dumbell с обеими руками, grasping  головой вас  гантель instead вас  handle. Ваши руки должны используйте вытянуты и свешены на  waist. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Поднимите  вес пока его   над лопатки , держите ваши руки вытянуты. Ваши тело и бедра должны remain stationary throughout  movement. Вернуться к  начальное положение и повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

question_ru: Как делать Single Leg Butt Kick?
question_en: Как делать Single Ногу Butt Kick?
answer_ru: Single Leg Butt Kick. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Begin by standing on one leg, with the bent knee raised. This will be your start position. Using a countermovement jump, take off upward by extending the hip, knee, and ankle of the grounded leg. Immediately flex the knee and attempt to touch your butt with the heel of your jumping leg. Return the leg to a partially bent position underneath the hips and land. Your opposite leg should stay in relatively the same position throughout the drill.
answer_en: Single Ногу Butt Kick. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Начните сгибая стойку на одну ногу, с  согнуты колено raised. Это будет используйте ваши начните положение. Используя  countermovement jump, take над вверх сгибая вытянув  таза, колено, и ankle вас  grounded ногу. Immediately согните  колено и attempt к касаться ваши butt с  heel вас ваши jumping ногу. Вернуться  ногу к  partially согнуты положение underneath  бедра и land. Ваши opposite ногу должны stay в relatively  same положение throughout  drill.

question_ru: Как делать Single Leg Glute Bridge?
question_en: Как делать Single Ногу Glute Bridge?
answer_ru: Single Leg Glute Bridge. Целевые мышцы: glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Lay on the floor with your feet flat and knees bent. Raise one leg off of the ground, pulling the knee to your chest. This will be your starting position. Execute the movement by driving through the heel, extending your hip upward and raising your glutes off of the ground. Extend as far as possible, pause and then return to the starting position.
answer_en: Single Ногу Glute Bridge. Целевые мышцы: glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Lay на  полом с ваши ногами плотно и коленями согнуты. Поднимите одну ногу над вас  полу, тяните  колено к ваши груди. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Execute  movement сгибая driving через  heel, вытянув ваши таза вверх и raising ваши glutes над вас  полу. Выпрямите как максимально как possible, пауза и затем вернуться к  начальное положение.

answer_ru: Single Leg Push-off. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Stand on the ground with one foot resting on the box, heel close to the edge. Push off with your foot on top of the box, trying to gain as much height as possible by extending through the hip and knee. Land with the same foot on top of the box, returning your other foot back to the start position.
answer_en: Single Ногу Push-off. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, hamstrings. Оборудование: другую. Уровень: beginner. Категория: plyometrics. Встаньте на  полу с одну ноги лежат на  box, heel close к  краю. Отжмитесь над с ваши ноги на верхние вас  box, trying к gain как much  как possible сгибая вытянув через  таза и колено. Land с  same ноги на верхние вас  box, returning ваши другую ноги обратно к  начните положение.

answer_ru: Sit-Up. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: body only. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees. Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position. Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise. Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
answer_en: Sit-Up. Целевые мышцы: abdominals. Оборудование: тело только. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Лягте вниз на  полом ставив ваши ногами either под something that будет not move или сгибая having  partner держите им. Ваши ноги должны используйте согнуты на  коленями. Месте ваши руками за ваши головой и lock им вместе сгибая clasping ваши fingers. Это    начальное положение. Elevate ваши верхние тело so that его creates an imaginary V-shape с ваши thighs. Дышите  when performing это part вас  exercise. Once вы чувствуете  сокращения на  секунды, опустите ваши верхние тело обратно вниз к  начальное положение   inhaling. Повторите на  рекомендуемое количество вас повторений.

answer_ru: Sit Squats. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: stretching. Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position. Begin the movement by flexing your knees and hips, sitting back with your hips. Continue until you have squatted a portion of the way down, but are above parallel, and quickly reverse the motion until you return to the starting position. Repeat for 5-10 repetitions.
answer_en: Сядьте Squats. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: beginner. Категория: вытягивая. Встаньте с ваши ногами лопатки ширине в стороны. Это будет используйте ваши начальное положение. Начните  movement сгибая flexing ваши коленями и бедра, sitting обратно с ваши бедра. Continue пока вы have squatted  portion вас  путь вниз, but   над параллельны, и быстро выполните  движение пока вы вернуться к  начальное положение. Повторите на 5-10 повторений.

answer_ru: Skating. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abductors, adductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: other. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: cardio. Roller skating is a fun activity which can be effective in improving cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular endurance. It requires relatively good balance and coordination. It is necessary to learn the basics of skating including turning and stopping and to wear protective gear to avoid possible injury. You can skate at a comfortable pace for 30 minutes straight. If you want a cardio challenge, do interval skating — speed skate two minutes of every five minutes, using the remaining three minutes to recover. Position the bar at knee height and load it to an appropriate weight. Take a pronated grip on the bar outside of shoulder width and unhook the bar from the machine. Your arms should be fully extended with your head and chest up. Your elbows should be pointed out with your shoulders back and down. Your hips should be back, loading the tension into the hamstrings. This will be your starting position. Initate the movement by forcefully extending the hips and knees, accelerating into the bar. Ensure that you keep your arms straight during this part of the motion. Upon full extension, rebend the hips and knees to lower your receiving position. Allow the arms to flex at this point, rotating the elbows around the bar to receive it on your shoulders. Extend through the hips and knees to come to a standing position with the bar racked on your shoulders to complete the movement.

question_ru: Как делать Smith Machine Incline Bench Press?

answer_ru: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press. Целевые мышцы: chest, shoulders, triceps. Оборудование: machine. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Place an incline bench underneath the smith machine. Place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the incline bench and make sure your upper chest is aligned with the barbell. Using a pronated grip (palms facing forward) that is wider than shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position. As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your upper chest. After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions. When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.

Continue alternating, rotating from one side to the other until the set is complete.

answer_ru: Split Clean. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, forearms, glutes, hamstrings, lower back, shoulders, traps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: olympic weightlifting. With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take an overhand grip just outside the legs. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position. Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees. Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended. As full extension is achieved, transition into the third pull by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the elbows up and out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating your elbows under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar with the feet split, aggressively moving one foot forward and one foot back. The bar should be racked onto the protracted shoulders, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom position, which will help in the recovery. Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Bring the feet together as you stand up.

answer_ru: Split Jerk. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings, shoulders, triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: olympic weightlifting. Standing with the weight racked on the front of the shoulders, begin with the dip. With your feet directly under your hips, flex the knees without moving the hips backward. Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move your head out of the way as the bar leaves the shoulders. At this moment as the feet leave the floor, the feet must be placed into the receiving position as quickly as possible. In the brief moment the feet are not actively driving against the platform, the athlete's effort to push the bar up will drive them down. The feet should be moved to a split stance, one foot forward, one foot back, with the knees partially bent. Receive the bar with the arms locked out overhead. Return to a standing position, bringing the feet together.

Absorb the impact by reverting back to the starting position.

answer_ru: Split Snatch. Целевые мышцы: hamstrings, calves, forearms, glutes, hamstrings, lower back, quadriceps, shoulders, traps, triceps. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: expert. Категория: olympic weightlifting. Begin with a loaded barbell on the floor. The bar should be close to or touching the shins, and a wide grip should be taken on the bar. The feet should be directly below the hips, with the feet turned out as needed. Lower the hips, with the chest up and the head looking forward. The shoulders should be just in front of the bar. This will be the starting position. Begin the first pull by driving through the front of the heels, raising the bar from the ground. The back angle should stay the same until the bar passes the knees. Transition into the second pull by extending through the hips knees and ankles, driving the bar up as quickly as possible. The bar should be close to the body. At peak extension, shrug the shoulders and allow the elbows to flex to the side. As you move your feet into the receiving position, forcefully pull yourself below the bar as you elevate the bar overhead. The feet should move forcefully to a split position, one foot forward one foot back. Receive the bar with your body as low as possible and the arms fully extended overhead. Keeping the bar aligned over the front of the heels, your head and chest up, drive through heels of the feet to move to a standing position, bringing your feet together. Carefully return the weight to floor.

answer_ru: Squat with Bands. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, adductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings, lower back. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: powerlifting. Set up the bands on the sleeves, secured to either band pegs, the rack, or dumbbells so that there is appropriate tension. Begin by stepping under the bar and placing it across the back of the shoulders. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and rotate your elbows forward, attempting to bend the bar across your shoulders. Remove the bar from the rack, creating a tight arch in your lower back, and step back into position. Place your feet wide for more emphasis on the back, glutes, adductors, and hamstrings. Keep your head facing forward. With your back, shoulders, and core tight, push your knees and butt out and you begin your descent. Sit back with your hips as much as possible. Ideally, your shins should be perpendicular to the ground. Lower bar position necessitates a greater torso lean to keep the bar over the heels. Continue until you break parallel, which is defined as the crease of the hip being in line with the top of the knee. Keeping the weight on your heels and pushing your feet and knees out, drive upward as you lead the movement with your head. Continue upward, maintaining tightness head to toe, until you have returned to the starting position.

To begin, first set the bar on a rack to just below shoulder level. Position a weight plate on the ground a couple feet back from the rack. Once the bar is loaded, step under it and place the back of your shoulders across it. Hold on to the bar with both hands and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straighten your torso. Step away from the rack and adopt a wide stance with the toes slightly pointed out, with one foot on the weight plate. Keep your head up at all times. This will be your starting position. Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees and hips. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees. At the top of the movement, side step, bringing your feet together on the opposite side of the plate. Using your inside foot, push the weight plate, sliding it across the floor to where you were just standing. Place your inside foot on the weight plate, adopting a wide stance for the next repetition.

As you inhale, bring the legs back to the initial position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions. Perform the same exercise now for the left leg.

As you breathe out, move the dumbbells up using your triceps and the same semi-circular motion but in reverse. Attempt to keep the dumbbells together as they move up. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down again slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up. Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions of your training program.

Maintain proper posture as you walk, and only hold onto the handles when necessary, such as when dismounting or checking your heart rate.

Note on grips: For a wide grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance wider than shoulder width. For a medium grip, your hands need to be spaced out at a distance equal to your shoulder width and for a close grip at a distance smaller than your shoulder width. As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position. As you breathe out, bring the bar down until it touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull down the bar using the forearms. After a second at the contracted position squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement. Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

The forearms should do no other work except for holding the bar; therefore do not try to pull down the bar using the forearms. After a second on the contracted position squeezing your shoulder blades together, slowly raise the bar back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched. Inhale during this portion of the movement. Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

question_ru: Как делать Wide Stance Barbell Squat?
question_en: Как делать Wide Stance Barbell Присядьте?
answer_ru: Wide Stance Barbell Squat. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, glutes, hamstrings, lower back. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it. Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a wider-than-shoulder-width stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance, and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

Keep your back straight, and your head and chest up. This will be your starting position. Begin the movement be engaging the hips, driving them forward as you allow the arms to hang straight. Continue until you are standing straight up, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position. For successive reps, the weight need not touch the floor.

answer_ru: World's Greatest Stretch. Целевые мышцы: hamstrings, calves, glutes, quadriceps. Оборудование: не указано. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: stretching. This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your front foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your back foot. With your knees bent, squat down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds. Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either side of your front foot. Raise the toes of the front foot off of the ground, and straighten your leg. You may need to reposition your rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other side.

question_ru: Как делать Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar?

answer_ru: Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar. Целевые мышцы: forearms. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Alternating between each of your hands, perform the movement by extending the wrist as though you were rolling up a newspaper. Continue alternating back and forth until failure. Reverse the motion by flexing the wrist, rolling the opposite direction. Continue the alternating motion until failure.

Alternating между каждой вас ваши руками, выполняете  movement сгибая вытянув  wrist как though вы were rolling вверх  newspaper. Continue alternating обратно и forth пока failure. Выполните  движение сгибая flexing  wrist, rolling  opposite direction. Continue  alternating движение пока failure.

answer_ru: Yoke Walk. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, abdominals, abductors, adductors, calves, glutes, hamstrings, lower back. Оборудование: other. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strongman. answer_ru: Zercher Squats. Целевые мышцы: quadriceps, calves, glutes, hamstrings. Оборудование: barbell. Уровень: expert. Категория: strength. This exercise is best performed inside a squat rack for safety purposes. To begin, first set the bar on a rack that best matches your height. The correct height should be anywhere above the waist but below the chest. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, lock your hands together and place the bar on top of your arms in between the forearm and upper arm. Lift the bar up so that it is resting on top of your forearms. If you are holding the bar properly, it should look as if you have your arms crossed but with a bar running across them. Step away from the rack and position your legs using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Keep your head up at all times as looking down will get you off balance and also maintain a straight back. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances discussed in the foot stances section). Begin to lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly. Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

answer_ru: Zottman Curl. Целевые мышцы: biceps, forearms. Оборудование: dumbbell. Уровень: intermediate. Категория: strength. Stand up with your torso upright and a dumbbell in each hand being held at arms length. The elbows should be close to the torso. Make sure the palms of the hands are facing each other. This will be your starting position. While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Your wrist should rotate so that you have a supinated (palms up) grip. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second as you squeeze the biceps. Now during the contracted position, rotate your wrist until you now have a pronated (palms facing down) grip with the thumb at a higher position than the pinky. Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back down using the pronated grip. As the dumbbells close your thighs, start rotating the wrist so that you go back to a neutral (palms facing your body) grip. Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

answer_ru: Kettlebell Halo. Целевые мышцы: shoulders, traps, middle back, abdominals, triceps. Оборудование: kettlebells. Уровень: beginner. Категория: strength. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Hold a kettlebell upside down by the horns, with the bell above your hands and close to your chest. Brace your abdominals and squeeze your glutes so your ribcage stays down. This is your starting position. Keeping your elbows close to your head, move the kettlebell up past one ear and around behind your head. Continue the circle past the opposite ear and back down to the starting position in front of your chest, letting the bell pass close to your body throughout. Complete the prescribed number of circles in one direction, then repeat the same number in the opposite direction. Move slowly and keep your head, hips and lower back still. If your lower back arches or the bell drifts far from your head, use a lighter weight.
